TOQUE PARA VOLTEAR · TAP TO FLIP

Esta tarjeta lleva un chip adentro. Al acercarla al teléfono se abrió esta página — no hizo falta instalar nada ni abrir ninguna cuenta.

La dirección no va a cambiar. Lo que sí va a cambiar es lo que hay aquí: cada cierto tiempo se agrega algo nuevo, así que si vuelve a tocar la tarjeta más adelante, va a encontrar algo que hoy no está.

This card has a chip in it, and tapping it opened this page — nothing to install, no account. The address will not change. What is on the page will: entries are added over time, so tapping it again later will find something that is not here today.

TARJETA
CR-80 · 85.6 × 53.98 mm · NTAG215

GT-001 is held, not listed. The network lists a project only when someone else could fork it and build on it — a repository, a licence, a way to send the maker a wish. This card has none of those yet, and saying so is the point of the network rather than a disclaimer. The cards are made with Card Studio, which prints and programs them on a desktop inkjet and ships both of these faces as templates.

Artwork by Meta AI, commissioned by the card's owner.
